title: Holy islands: monks, hermits and the edge of the world
excerpt: Skellig Michael, Iona, Lindisfarne, Bardsey: I checked 20,228 monasteries, abbeys and hermitages across Europe against a detailed shoreline. Before 800, 4.3% of dated houses stood on islands; after 1100, about one in a hundred.
seo_description: Island monasteries in Europe mapped: 459 of 20,228 monastic houses in Wikidata stand on islands, most often the earliest ones.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Holy islands' in dark slate and rust red on pale paper, beside a map of Europe where grey dots mark 20,228 monastic houses and larger red, blue and green dots mark the 459 on islands, clustered around western Ireland and Scotland and across the Aegean.
